narrative.overview: Jochona's marketing surface reads as a celestial/nautical navigation chart, not a SaaS dashboard. A homelab owner plots one short course: device, network, host, the way a navigator plots a bearing. An instrument bezel with ticks, a plotted line that draws in once, and small mono coordinate readouts stand in for data the product can actually prove, never invented metrics. The crescent-and-orbital-trail brand mark is the astrolabe at the center of the hero.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy ground chosen for the use scene (living room / desk at night)
Brass-gold instrument linework for structure; cyan reserved for live/active state and the primary action
Mono readouts used only where they carry real information
One authored motion moment: the hero plot line draws in once on load

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cyan is the only saturated, high-chroma color on the page, marking exactly one thing per view: live/active state or the primary action.

rules.name: The Diegetic Label Rule
rules.body: Every mono label belongs to the chart's own instrument (a bearing, a spec, a log mark); no mono label is used as a page-wide kicker.

rules.name: The No-Card Rule
rules.body: No component gets a background box, radius, or shadow to read as a card; grouping uses shared bezels, dividers, and continued plotted lines.

dos: Do reserve cyan for exactly one job per view.
Do keep mono labels diegetic to the chart.
Do use full 1px borders for panels, never a colored border-left/right heavier than 1px.
Do keep motion to one authored moment per view and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label above any heading.
Don't put icon+heading+text into an elevated card shell.
Don't introduce a second saturated accent color.
